title: Calderón uniqueness for bounded measurable real isotropic conductivities
exact_target: Do all boundary voltage-to-current measurements uniquely determine a bounded measurable positive scalar conductivity in dimension at least three?

sources.citation: Matteo Santacesaria, Note on Calderón's inverse problem for measurable conductivities, Inverse Problems and Imaging13(1)(2019),149–157; arXiv1803.06931v2.
